Everything your website includes

Not just a pretty page — a complete setup that helps customers find you, trust you, and contact you in one tap, on any device.

Fully responsive design

Phone, tablet, laptop or big desktop — the layout, text and buttons resize and rearrange to fit the screen perfectly. No pinching, no sideways scrolling.

On-site chat assistant

A chat assistant sits on your website and answers visitors from your own services, prices and opening hours — even at 10pm when you're closed. Try the one on this page.

Google visibility setup

Correct hours, photos, services, categories and map pin on your Google Business Profile — so “near me” searches actually show your shop.

Tap-to-call & booking forms

Big, thumb-friendly call buttons and simple enquiry / booking forms — a visitor can reach you in one tap, without hunting for your number.

Fast on every connection

Lightweight pages with optimised photos that open quickly on mobile data — because a slow site loses customers before they even see it.

Draft first, pay later

You see a live draft with your real details first. Ask for changes until it feels like yours — you only pay if you love it. No advance, no lock-in.

How it works

Simple, and safe for you: you see the finished draft before any money changes hands.

Pip's promise: you don't pay a cent until step 4 — and only if you love the draft. Follow the steps, I'll be right here.
1

Say hello

Email me or DM me on Instagram with your shop's name and what you sell. That's all I need to start.

2

I check & build your draft

I check how your shop appears on Google today, then build your website draft with your real details.

3

You review it

I send you the live draft link. Ask for any changes — colours, photos, prices — until it feels like yours.

4

Pay only if you love it

Happy with the draft? Then you pay, and your site goes live for your customers. Not happy? You pay nothing.

About me

Hi, I'm Ranvir Bree — a website designer for local businesses. I help local shops go online — the salon on the corner, the family restaurant, the neighbourhood clinic — businesses that are great at what they do, but hard to find on Google.

I kept seeing the same story: a shop with happy customers and good reviews, losing new customers simply because its Google profile had the wrong hours, no photos, or no website at all. So I started fixing exactly that — clean 1-page and multi-page websites, plus properly set-up Google Business Profiles, at prices a small shop can actually afford.

I work draft-first because I think you should never pay for something you haven't seen. You get a real, live draft of your website, with your details in it — and only then decide.
